summary: Tested Landline to Texting plan pricing on the backend and in the UI (preview dry-run). Backend: 11 of 12 pytest checks pass. Passing: GET planPrices/planLimits/plans; needs_plan (Bob); pick_plan (no planNumber or a number Alice doesn't own); plan_inactive; Starter 5/$150 and Pro 10/$120 limits (plan_limit on the next one, price charged right); Business $100 in both code and nocode modes, with item planNumber/plan/monthly 0 and exactly one hosted-sms-setup transaction; three parallel clicks give one debit; cancel refunds $100 and a second cancel does not refund again; admin reject refunds $100. Full flow verify, documents, review and auto-active works with no nextBillAt. Plan sync works: plan expired leads to paused with a note within one tick, and plan active again turns texting back on with the note cleared. Bob's legacy $50/month docs keep their nextBillAt. Inbound hosted text goes to the Inbox (regression script). The one failure is copy: sending a text on a paused plan-attached number returns 'the $50 monthly fee is due'. UI (1920 and 390): price cells show $150/$120/$100/$0.05; steps 1-3 appear in order; the plan card shows 'Business plan $100 · Unlimited · 0 added'; mode cards show no price; the button reads 'Pay $100 from wallet'; after paying come the code step (123456), then details and bill, then review, then active (~1 min). The panel shows 'Renews with your business plan on +13346972125, no monthly fee'. The paused panel shows the plan-specific copy. Inactive and full (5 of 5) plan cards are disabled and the pay button shows 'Pick a plan'. Bob sees texting-needs-plan, and its link goes to /cloudivr/app/buy. No page errors.

minor.issue: On a paused plan-attached number the error says 'Texting is paused — the $50 monthly fee is due. Top up your wallet.' (js/hosted-sms.js sendText, line ~389). It should say the plan on <planNumber> isn't active, renew it. Same problem in onInbound logs only (fine).
The plan-limit check (plansFor count, then insert) is not atomic. Parallel setups for different numbers on a Starter/Pro plan with 4 of 5 used can all pass and go over the limit. Low risk.

issues: Shows the same message twice: texting-panel-note 'Paused: the plan on +1… isn't active.' plus the texting-paused info line. Hide the note when status is paused and planNumber is set.
The plan name is lowercase in 'Renews with your business plan'. Consider capitalising it ('Business plan') to match the plan cards.

action_items: In sendText, make the paused error plan-aware when d.planNumber is set: 'Texting is paused because the plan on X isn't active. Renew the plan.'
Optional: enforce the plan limit atomically, e.g. re-count after the insert and roll back if over the limit.
Optional: remove the duplicate paused note in NumberPanel for plan-attached numbers.
critical_code_review_comments: hosted-sms.js sendText still uses legacy $MONTHLY copy for paused plan-attached numbers.

Race on the plan limit in start(): there is a gap between plansFor() and insertOne. Only the unique index on the same phone protects against double charge; that index works (verified: 3 parallel clicks gave 1 debit).

Old test file backend/tests/test_hosted_sms_web.py depends on /app/memory/_hsid and _bill.pdf, which are missing now, and expects legacy $300/$500 standalone pricing without planNumber. It is out of date for the new flow. Use test_hosted_sms_plans.py.
